manifest: WS-A1 permit/allowlist re-keying input — schema intake_v1.1 (Era N Wave 1)
purpose: App-layer permit lists, GATE detectors, and structure checks MUST be generated from this manifest (which is derived from the schema + stage heading contracts) — never hand-tuned. Regenerate at every version event (see OPERATIONS.md, Version-Event Checklist Amendment).

h2_permitted: A) Executive Summary of Current State
stage1_dossier.detector_notes: Pain points are numbered 0..7 when PP-CORE-00 is instantiated (heading 'Pain Point 0 — …'); hypotheses 0..7 when H-CORE-00 is gated in ('Hypothesis 0 — …'). Detectors keyed to 1..8 / 1..7 will false-fail on conforming v1.1 documents.

stage2_snapshot.detector_notes: The '6/6 dimensions' detector must key on the H3 pattern above (v1.1 heading contract) OR the scorecard table rows — not on level-3 headings alone for pre-v1.1 documents. [BAND_ASSIGNMENT] is internal: permitted in the working snapshot, NEVER in any client-facing rendering.

stage3_map.detector_notes: Marker count = Stage 1 Section D count (7, or 8 incl. H-CORE-00). NOTE: Stage 3 sections are emitted at LEVEL 3 (matches app SECTION_ALLOWLISTS.stepD level:3, which ran correctly in v36) — do not re-key stepD without a matching contract change.

strip_always: engineering task codes (T-\d+, S-\d+, WL-\d+, REG-\d+)
field-syntax tokens at any position (d_gate4=, system_event_deadline=, compliance_deadline=, phase_dependency=, "score comment", standalone D6) — S-48; token-based, any form
stage4_sequence.detector_notes: GATE-4 verification must key on the Phase Summary table + the H2 phase headings above. Each undivided ID appears in exactly ONE Phase Summary row (T-30).

h1_permitted: 3. Key Findings: Where Value is Being Lost
strip_always_from_client_copy: ## [JUSTIFICATION] block IN ANY HEADING FORM — match the token '[JUSTIFICATION]' at ANY heading level, bold, or flattened text, not only '## [JUSTIFICATION]' (the Era-N T2 breach survived because the permit pattern was keyed to one heading form)
<!-- score: --> and <!-- pp-id: --> and <!-- INTAKE_FACTS --> blocks
product/tier language except the single pinned §7 sentence (preflight Pattern Set 8)
stage5_blueprint.detector_notes: Token-based stripping, not heading-level-based: any rendering that demotes or flattens headings must not defeat the strip.

renderer_contract.rule: The /step/:step/delivery renderer MUST pass markdown heading levels through unchanged (no H2/H3 demotion to bold or promotion to H1). If any markdown→DOCX/HTML→markdown roundtrip occurs, heading levels are part of the contract and their loss is a T-32/S-44 defect.
renderer_contract.verify: For each stage: heading census of the delivery copy equals the heading census of the raw copy after permitted strips.
